name: smwmusic-spyro-eternal-night-ancient-grove
title: Spyro: Eternal Night - Ancient Grove
description:
Ancient Grove is a mystical orchestral song from the GBA version of The Legend of Spyro: Eternal Night. It features strings, oboe, flute, harp, and various percussion. Perfect for nighttime forest levels.

Originally written by Tom Miller.

Requested by OrangeBronzeDaisy.
